_comment: The employee registry, in fixed execution order. 'script' is a path relative to AOS/, run as its own subprocess from its own directory; null means no runtime exists yet and the step is recorded NOT_EXECUTABLE, never simulated. 'dependsOn' lists employee keys that must finish SUCCESS or NOT_EXECUTABLE before this one runs. 'outputPaths' are well-known files (supporting a {date} placeholder) the Orchestrator checks for after a SUCCESS, purely by filesystem existence, never parsed for business logic. See ../../dependency-map.md for the reasoning behind every entry.

employees.name: Revenue Hunter
employees.note: Implemented in revenue-hunter/, not 08-Revenue-Hunter/ — see dependency-map.md.

employees.name: CRM
employees.note: Implemented in crm/, not 06-CRM/ — see dependency-map.md. Read-only report generator over company-intelligence.json; never writes relationshipTemperature/nextFollowUpDue/outreachHistory, which remain Sales Director's exclusively. Also reads sales-director/runtime/processed-index.json for proposal history, but CRM runs before Sales Director in the fixed order, so that read reflects the previous run's state, not this run's — a one-cycle-behind limitation, not a dependsOn edge (see crm-runtime-notes.md and revenue-hunter-runtime-notes.md for the same pattern).

employees.name: Service Mapping Engine
employees.note: New in Sprint 3 — deterministically maps every opportunity to a Primary Service, Secondary Services, Recommended Engagement Type, Estimated Project Size, Recommended Proposal Template and Cross-Sell Opportunities. Reads opportunity-schema.json (required) plus pipeline.json/company-intelligence.json (optional enrichment only), all read-only; runs after CRM and before Sales Director so Sales Director can read its output the same day. See service-mapping/service-mapping-model.md.
